# Video Poster Design Skill for Muse

Creates cinematic movie posters and key art for a film, short, vlog, or campaign: it proposes 3–5 visually distinct creative directions first (character-led, environmental, symbolic, motion, minimal teaser), then generates the chosen one into a final poster image — default 3:4 — saved under `posters/` with a reusable spec file for consistent regeneration. Typography direction is genre-aware (severe condensed type for thrillers, soft serifs for romance, kinetic layouts for sports), character identity is preserved from reference sheets or storyboards, and a negative-prompt list guards against generic templates, garbled text, and deformed hands. Discovered via skills.sh. Honest note: the skill writes the creative direction, prompts, and specs — but the final image must be rendered by an image-generation tool, which is not included; your environment needs one available for the skill to produce anything. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use. Not verified.
